summary: ProfileHistory is a user control in HSPnet that displays and filters the historical records of a staff profile. It uses a dropdown (ddScreenSection) to allow selection of different sections of staff history (e.g., Training, Placements, Education). The relevant records for the staff member are displayed in a grid (gridData) and filtered based on section selection. The UI is dynamically constructed based on the actual data available for the staff member. Additional UI controls facilitate display and printing.
purpose: To provide an interface for viewing a staff member's historical profile data, grouped by relevant sections (such as Training, Placements, Education, Certifications, etc.), with filtering and display functionality for administrators or authorized users.

workflows.name: Display filtered staff profile history
steps: User navigates to the ProfileHistory control.
StaffPRHistoryList is initialized for the current StaffID and session.
Dropdown ddScreenSection is cleared and repopulated with 'ALL' plus a dynamic set of section options.
The system checks for data existence in each section using EntryExistsOfType and adds dropdown options accordingly (e.g., Training, Placements, Certifications, etc.).
Dropdown is set to the previously selected or default value.
Based on dropdown selection, bindData is either all records or filtered by the selected screen section.
Data is bound to gridData for display.
User can print details using btnPrintDetails.

business_rules: Only sections with at least one corresponding record in data.Data are shown in the dropdown.
If no section is selected, 'ALL' is set as default.
Selection in ddScreenSection filters the displayed history to the chosen section.
validations: Check for existence of section data before adding to dropdown (EntryExistsOfType).
Dropdown selection must be one of the sections present for the staff.
conditions: If UserSession is not null, binding occurs.
If no selection in dropdown, 'ALL' is used.
If screenSection == 'ALL', all data is shown; otherwise, filter by screenSection.
system_behavior: Dynamically builds the filter dropdown based on available data.
Binds and displays relevant staff profile history in a grid.
Supports printing the currently displayed staff history details.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, no binding or data display occurs.
If ddScreenSection selection is invalid or missing, defaults are applied.
content_gaps: No database schema or data model details for StaffPRHistory fields.
No explicit UI layout or view templates.
No details on authentication/authorization mechanisms for users.
